pitfalls:
Inno {localappdata} resolves to original user's path only when installer is launched non-elevated (UAC prompt). If user right-clicks Setup.exe → 'Run as administrator', {localappdata} maps to admin account. Mitigation: document 'do not run as admin'; Inno's PrivilegesRequired=admin triggers UAC internally and preserves original user context.
Helper exe must be built with same cpr/libcurl/nlohmann_json as plugin to guarantee identical HTTP behavior (Range resume, User-Agent, error surfaces). Static linking preferred to avoid DLL hell in {tmp}.
macOS AuthorizationExecuteWithPrivileges is deprecated but still works; SMJobBless requires a separate privileged helper tool (more code). For v0.3, AuthorizationExecuteWithPrivileges is acceptable; file radar for SMJobBless migration.
Progress parsing: stdout lines must be flushed (std::cout << std::flush) after each 'PROGRESS' line; Inno ExecWait and NSTask both buffer. Use unbuffered stdio (setvbuf(stdout, nullptr, _IONBF, 0)).
Model destination on Windows: {localappdata}\CorridorKey2.0-BMT\models (per-user). On macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/CorridorKey2.0-BMT/models. Both match existing user_models_root() in runtime_paths.hpp.
Track selection: Windows defaults to fp16 (TorchTRT + ONNX fp16). macOS defaults to mlx (safetensors + bridges + hint ONNX). Installer UI could expose a dropdown but v0.3 can hardcode per-platform default.
Cleanup on cancel: helper writes .part files; on cancel, leave .part for resume. Inno/Cocoa should NOT delete {tmp} helper until after parsing final 'DONE' line.
CI changes: add corridors_key_model_fetch to Windows and macOS build matrices; upload as artifact; Inno script references {tmp} path; macOS DMG stage copies helper into .app/Contents/Resources/.
Plugin first-run removal: ensure_model_pack() writes model_pack_status.json with stage='installer-model-fetch' (new value) so doctor/CLI can distinguish installer vs first-run fetches. OFX panel reads this and shows 'Model pack ready' immediately.
